title: Door lock and rear door access
summary: This topic centers on door lock and unlock behavior, especially rear-door access, configurable unlock settings, and the placement or availability of door locking controls.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise configurable lock and unlock options and the convenience of family-friendly access preferences.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize hard-to-use driver-door lock buttons and the lack of convenient rear-door locking or unlocking access.

mixed.summary: The mixed review notes general annoyance with having to open a front door before the rear door can be unlocked from outside.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly describe menu paths or customer situations about all-door unlock settings and rear-door behavior without a clear evaluative stance.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so clear sentiment evidence is limited.
Several undetermined examples are procedural instructions or partial statements, which restricts confidence about the underlying customer attitude.
The sample focuses on both settings guidance and feature expectations around rear-door access, which are related but not always clearly evaluative.
